claim: Add completed-history workspace and assembled browser proof — the repair diff (1b71b3895e86..21723caf67f9) in serve/cockpit/web/src/hooks/useWorkItems.ts closes the loadMore stale-overwrite race identified in the prior review, without introducing a new stuck or unresolved defect.
evidence: In useCompletedHistory (serve/cockpit/web/src/hooks/useWorkItems.ts lines 75-136), the query/retry effect assigns `const generation = ++requestGeneration.current` and both its `.then` and `.catch` branches gate on `active && generation === requestGeneration.current`, so any query change or retry invalidates in-flight completion of the prior effect run.

loadMore (same file, lines 108-131) captures `const generation = requestGeneration.current` and `const requestedQuery = query` before awaiting, then both its success and error paths return early `if (generation !== requestGeneration.current || requestedQuery !== latestQuery.current)`, discarding a stale pagination page instead of overwriting fresh state — directly resolving the finding from review-target-delivery-cutover-out008-task005-fe41854c.

retry() (lines 133-136) synchronously does `requestGeneration.current += 1` before `setRetryNonce`, invalidating any in-flight loadMore immediately, since retry does not change `query` and would otherwise not be caught by the `latestQuery` check alone.

serve/cockpit/web/src/__tests__/WorkPortfolio.test.tsx 'ignores an older completed page after the search query changes' (lines 191-227) reproduces the exact prior race: it starts an unresolved 'Load more' fetch, changes the search query to 'beta' and observes the fresh result, then resolves the stale older page afterward and asserts `screen.queryByText('Stale page')` is absent while 'Beta search' remains — matching the claimed regression scope.

Traced the other hooks in the same file (useWorkPortfolio, useCompletedChange, useWorkItemDetail) — each keys its effect solely on identity/retryNonce with a single `active` boolean guard and no independent pagination path, so none combine a mutable cursor with an independently changing query the way useCompletedHistory does; no analogous unaddressed stale-success/error race was found, and no new state-stuck path was introduced (isLoading is always resolved by whichever fetch's generation currently matches).
get_errors on both changed files (hooks/useWorkItems.ts, __tests__/WorkPortfolio.test.tsx) returned no diagnostics, consistent with the reported clean editor diagnostics and passing proof.
